analysis_plan.baseline: Reuse independently verified primary-cohort runs at the same seed labels; do not relabel or count them as new runs.
analysis_plan.design: One factor at a time; two stress levels per factor; seven reference settings; omit inactive parameter-setting combinations.
analysis_plan.effects: Mean seed-paired second-minus-first mortality change, and its seed-paired difference from the primary contrast, in percentage points.
analysis_plan.intervals: Unadjusted 95% Monte Carlo t intervals across common seed labels; these are finite-seed precision, not empirical or structural uncertainty intervals.
analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Integer deaths at hour 408 divided by 972.
analysis_plan.ranges: Deliberate assumption stress tests, not empirical uncertainty distributions.
analysis_plan.sampling: Fixed replication budget; no extension or stopping based on significance.
analysis_plan.scope: Local robustness under specified ranges; no global sensitivity indices, variance attribution or joint-factor robustness claim.
analysis_plan.tests: Exact two-sided sign-flip tests on integer death-count changes in contrasts; Holm correction across all 30 applicable factor-level-contrast modifications.
